name: forecast-dispersion-ic
notes: T2 of the 2026-10-11 edge-and-harvest research note (A1127/A1128), ADR-0259: does the PatchTST forecast's SCALE order the names beyond what the option market implies? Per quote date, the rank correlation across names of forecast sd with |realized 31-day log move| GIVEN the implied ATM straddle ratio (the partial Spearman: both sides rank-regressed on the straddle within the date, residuals correlated), tested over the dates with the toolkit's per-timestamp IC (a Newey-West mean over the stamp series; the owned test, in place of the note's block bootstrap, same question). AMENDMENT, recorded before any run: the note wrote T2 as the ratio form, forecast sd / implied against |move| / implied. That ratio is Pearson's spurious correlation (one noisy denominator on both sides): in a dry run on synthetic rows a PURE-NOISE forecast scored IC +0.32 with t = 7.2 under it, and a forecast that was only a function of the implied scale kept t > 5 after being permuted within each date. The partial form answers the pre-registered question (information beyond the market) without that artifact, so the pass rule is read on beyond_market: mean IC > 0 with t >= 2.5. Two controls on the same rows: forecast_alone (the forecast sd against |move|, no control) and implied_alone (the straddle ratio against |move|): the market's own ordering skill, the bar the forecast must add to. INPUTS are the v2 replay's saved inputs only (condor-replay-inputs-20261009-v5: forecasts = the exact saved seed-11 curves, chain = the exact-DTE-31 trade bars, bars = as-traded closes), all pre-2026; nothing is fitted and no 2026 price is read. CLOCK: the forecast and the straddle are both taken at the quote date's close (same-day, the ADR-0258 decision clock); the realized move settles on the expiry's as-traded close or the latest earlier session (horizon-pairs, 31 calendar days, fallback previous: the replay's own settlement rule) and is known only after expiry. PRICE BASIS: both attachments agree on spot (the as-traded close) between the straddle's denominator, the forecast row and the pairs' entry close, so a basis mismatch REFUSES instead of correlating two bases; if that refusal fires, the finding is the mismatch, not the IC. The implied straddle ratio is (call vwap + put vwap) / close at the in-band strike nearest the money with both sides traded in the DTE-31 expiry: about 0.8 * sigma * sqrt(T), a constant factor that cancels in ranks; null where no in-band strike has both sides traded. The forecast sd is the analytic standard deviation of the saved mixture or Student mixture times the row's reference (return units). All three measures score the SAME rows: the scored filter keeps a row only when its forecast sd, its straddle ratio and its realized move are all present; the unfiltered rows, nulls included, are written for audit. No earnings calendar is among the saved inputs, so the note's T4-proxy repeat is not run here; the by-phase and by-month splits are (a month holds about four stamps, so its HAC t is withheld by the node and only its mean IC is read). h_steps 5: the stamps are weekly (an expiry exactly 31 days out falls on a Friday from a Tuesday) and a 31-day label overlaps about four of them. Owner-run: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-forecast-dispersion-ic.json --asof 2025-12-31 from children/index_options on the WSL host that holds the onboarding root.

outputs.notes: Beside the v2 replay's run root; excluded from the identity hash.

forecasts.notes: The exact saved seed-11 curves of the v2 replay (ADR-0258): one standardized-return curve per (symbol, quote_date, expiry) with its reference (return scale) and as-traded spot. No inference, no fits, no later-checkpoint substitution.

chain.notes: The verified bounded exact-DTE-31 trade-bar chain the v2 replay decided on: one row per (contract, quote_date) with symbol, expiry, type (call/put), strike, vwap and volume.

bars.notes: The as-traded USD/share closes the v2 replay settled on (as_traded_close), all pre-2026.

bars_priced.notes: A bar whose as-traded close is missing, null or non-positive (an unreconciled history is a per-context refusal upstream) carries no price: it is dropped here, counted in the log, so neither the straddle's denominator nor the pairs read it.

chain_traded.notes: A chain row with no volume or no vwap is not a trade; the straddle reads traded bars only.

forecast_scale.notes: The forecast's scale: the analytic standard deviation of the saved curve, in standardized units (forecast_sd_z) and in return units (forecast_sd = sd_z * reference). keep projects the rows to exactly the identity, the agreed spot and the family fields the attachment below declares; a curve that cannot be restored or a non-positive reference refuses by row.

forecast_priced.notes: A saved forecast row whose as-traded price basis the replay refused (basis_refusal: unknown_historical_price_basis, outside_declared_phase, split_inside_holding_window, irregular_postdate_split_basis, source_vintage_unreconciled) carries spot null by design: 80,112 of 99,225 rows. Those rows leave here, counted in the log, before anything is attached, so the attachment's exact spot agreement is never asked of a row that has no basis. Rows inside a split's holding window leave with them, which also keeps an unadjusted close across a split out of the realized move. Added before any T2 IC existed (ADR-0259 amendment 2).

params.clock_note: same-day: the forecast and the straddle are both taken at the quote date's close, the ADR-0258 decision clock; the bar is known when the decision is taken

implied.notes: What the market implies for the same 31 days: the ATM straddle over the close, from the same chain the replay traded (the 0.05 band is the universe feature table's, workflow-features.json). underlying_close writes the denominator out as spot so both attachments can agree on it. Null where no in-band strike has both sides traded; the IC node drops and counts those rows.

implied_priced.notes: A straddle row whose (symbol, quote_date) has no priced bar carries spot null; the attachment's agreement check is exact and would refuse the whole run on one such row, so those rows leave here, counted in the log, before anything is attached.

realized.notes: The realized 31-day log move of every name from every close: the expiry is the quote date plus 31 calendar days (exact DTE 31), settled on that day's as-traded close or the latest earlier session, the replay's own rule (CondorExpirySettle, max gap 4). An entry whose expiry lies past the last pre-2026 close is dropped, never nulled. entry_close is named spot so the attachment agrees on it.

forecast.clock_note: the saved curve of the quote date's close (ADR-0258 decision clock): known when the decision is taken

with_forecast.notes: The forecast scale onto the implied rows by (symbol, quote_date); spot must agree exactly (the forecast's as-traded spot against the straddle's denominator). Forecast rows with no reconciled basis were dropped upstream (forecast_priced). At most 10% of implied rows may have no forecast (names outside the modeled 388, or without a reconciled basis); more refuses. The guard is unchanged from the first build.

realized.clock_note: settlement: the as-traded close on the expiry date or the latest earlier session; known only after expiry, never at the decision

with_realized.notes: The realized move onto the same rows; spot must agree exactly (the pairs' entry close is the same as-traded close). The settlement columns are label-time values: nothing downstream decides on them, the IC only scores.

phased.notes: The v2 replay's two windows (ExactDteBarChain windows: calibration 2024-02-06..2024-12-31, entry 2025-02-04..2025-11-28) stamped from the quote date itself, so the split does not depend on any upstream row carrying a phase. 'outside' names a date in neither window out loud; expected empty.

scored.notes: The one row set every measure scores: a forecast attached (forecast_sd present and positive), a two-sided in-band straddle (ratio positive) and a settled move (not null). A row failing any of the three leaves all three measures together, so the controls are read on exactly the rows the test is; the rows node writes the unfiltered rows with their attachment statuses for the census.

ic.notes: T2 itself. beyond_market is the amended pre-registered measure: within each quote date, the partial Spearman of the forecast sd with |realized log move| given the implied straddle ratio. forecast_alone and implied_alone are the controls. The attachments write family fields under their own names (forecast_sd, realized_log_move; the fc_/rz_ prefixes name only the status and reasons columns). The t is the Newey-West mean over the dates with the automatic band, at least h_steps - 1 = 4 (the 31-day label spans about four weekly stamps); usable is false if the median date carries fewer than 5 names; a split whose band spans its stamps reports its mean IC only (hac_withheld says so).

params.source: one row per (symbol, quote_date): implied straddle ratio, forecast sd, realized 31-day log move and settlement, all on the as-traded spot basis, with the attachment statuses and the phase

rows.notes: The audit rows the IC was computed from, so the regression slope (the note's kappa) or any other reading can be taken without recomputing. Overwritten on a rerun: the run directory keeps the hashed record.

params.source: one row per measure and quote date: the cross-sectional Spearman rho and the number of names ranked

by_stamp.notes: The per-date series the HAC mean was taken over.

report.notes: evidence.md renders the three measures, the drop census and the split table; evidence.json holds every value.
